_note: ADR-132 adversarial-verification remediation. Unlike ADR-131 this is a NARROW change, so the manifest is deliberately short and every screen NOT listed must be byte-identical — in particular every *-dark and *-playfuldark screen, because the Practice fix is light-only and everything else is dead-code removal. The baseline and candidate were both shot with the repaired harness (see px-diff.js: animation-iteration-count/fill-mode), whose determinism self-test now passes on all 32 screens. Note the harness seeds a PREMIUM profile, so the .kx-status-premium badge fix is invisible to px-diff — nothing is locked — and was verified by direct measurement and element screenshots instead.
practice-light: The grouping tray is restored. This rule had lost its background, so the mode cards floated directly on the page in both LIGHT themes while both dark themes kept their panel. Classic light takes --qr-panel = --qr-surface-3, a 22/255 delta against the page; --qr-surface would have been a 6/255 delta, which px-diff scored as literally zero changed pixels. Geometry is untouched: border-width still 0, radius 24px, padding 14.4px, margin 9.6px, panel 350px, card 321px.
practice-playful: Same restoration in Playful light, using its own warm-paper step (--qr-panel = --qr-surface-2, #f0eee9, a 14/255 delta). Playful cannot use --qr-surface: that value IS its page colour, so the tray would be invisible. Radius stays 28px and card geometry is unchanged.
